title: Field Estimating Rate Card: Line Sets, Duct Allowances and Change-Order Limits for Replacement System Installations
content:
# Field estimating rate card — Replacement System Installations

The figures below are the package-level rates the estimating side uses for work around a Replacement System Installations package: the listed change-order price of a new refrigerant line set, the duct transition footage included with the package, the per-foot price of duct modification beyond that footage, and the ceiling on signed change orders as a share of the contract price.

| Package | Line-set change-order price | Duct transition included (linear feet) | Duct modification beyond the allowance (per linear foot) | Most signed change orders may add (percent of the contract price) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | $895.00 | 10 | $38.00 | 20 |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | $895.00 | 10 | $38.00 | 20 |
| Harbison Performance Series System | $0.00 (line set included) | 15 | $38.00 | 20 |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | $0.00 (line set included) | 15 | $38.00 | 20 |
| Harbison Signature Series System | $0.00 (line set included) | 20 | $38.00 | 20 |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | $0.00 (line set included) | 25 | $38.00 | 20 |

## Notes to the card

- A line-set change-order price of $0.00 marks a package that already includes a new line set.
- Duct footage is counted in linear feet. Footage up to the included figure is part of the package; each foot beyond it is priced at the per-foot rate.
- The change-order ceiling is a percentage of that project's contract price.

## Worked figures (hypothetical projects)

- Duct work of 14 linear feet on a hypothetical Harbison Essential Series System project: 10 feet are included, 4 feet lie beyond the allowance, and 4 feet multiplied by $38.00 is $152.00.
- The same 14 feet on a hypothetical Harbison Performance Series System project lie within its 15-foot allowance, so no footage lies beyond it.
- On a hypothetical contract price of $10000.00, the 20 percent ceiling is $2000.00 of signed change orders.
